rationale: The primary limiter is structural dependence on an uncommitted accredited laboratory for distribution, integration, reusable data rights and enough comparable longitudinal data, while incumbent portals already offer generic trends and dashboards. The single redesign narrows the customer to multi-site hotels and replaces all-sample analytics with an operator-owned, expert-governed workflow for a lab-confirmed exceedance through documented intervention and accredited retest. A secure-upload pilot can test paid case activation without an initial lab connector, rights must be obtained directly and explicitly from the operator before any reuse, and the economic path changes from speculative high-volume low-priced sample analytics to fewer higher-value remediation cases plus an optional portfolio subscription. No partner commitment, rights, willingness to pay, price, margin, validation or traction is assumed.
